categories.main_business_segments: Tianjin Meiteng Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in intelligent equipment and intelligent systems and instruments for coal and mineral sorting, as well as related intelligent management systems. The company offers comprehensive solutions in coal sorting, non-coal mineral sorting, and recycling of renewable resources, including intelligent dry sorting machines, intelligent flotation systems, and solid-liquid separation equipment.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies such as X-ray transmission, computer vision, machine learning, and AI-driven large industry models ('Zhi Mei Master'). Core technologies include high-performance object positioning and segmentation, precise X-ray based classification algorithms, precise ejection technology, gradient fluidization sorting, and high-pressure filtration. Production methods emphasize lean manufacturing, automation, and integration of hardware and software systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are large and medium-sized coal and mineral production enterprises and beneficiation plants in China. The company also serves non-coal mining sectors and renewable resource recycling industries. Major end markets include coal mining and processing, non-ferrous mineral mining, lithium battery recycling, and environmental solid waste treatment.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with significant market presence in regions such as Shanxi, Shaanxi, Shandong, Inner Mongolia, and other domestic coal and mineral mining areas. It has expanded overseas markets including Southeast Asia, Russia, Central Asia, Mongolia, Africa, India, North America, Turkey, and Australia, with established experimental and sales centers abroad.
categories.supply_chain_position: Meiteng Technology operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on the design, manufacturing, and sales of intelligent sorting equipment and systems, as well as providing operational services and technical support to mining enterprises. It also extends upstream through joint ventures involved in equipment processing and manufacturing.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in intelligent dry sorting technology, AI-driven industry models, lithium battery recycling technology, and new solid-liquid separation equipment. It invests heavily in innovation with over 11% of revenue allocated to R&D, focusing on expanding applications from coal and mineral sorting to renewable resource recycling and environmental treatment. Strategic initiatives include digital twin systems, industry-specific AI models, and international market expansion.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of intelligent equipment and systems, customized project contracts, and after-sales services including technical support and operational management. The company also earns income from joint ventures and investments in related industrial projects.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Meiteng Technology holds a leading position in the domestic intelligent dry sorting market, especially in coal gangue sorting with the highest market share for its TDS intelligent dry sorting machines. It competes with other domestic and international companies in coal and mineral sorting equipment, intelligent mining systems, and recycling technologies, maintaining competitive advantages through continuous innovation and comprehensive product portfolios.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 546 million, a slight decline of 4.13% year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 40.68 million, down 45.21%. Despite short-term profit declines due to market competition and industry cyclicality, the company maintains a solid asset base with total assets around RMB 1.86 billion and continues to invest significantly in R&D and market expansion. Order intake increased by 37.08% in 2024, indicating growth potential.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Meiteng Technology emphasizes its advanced intelligent sorting technologies that enable high precision, energy efficiency, and environmental sustainability, such as dry sorting that reduces water usage and pollution. Its products integrate hardware and software for comprehensive intelligent mining solutions, including AI-driven decision-making and digital twin platforms. The company differentiates itself through strong R&D capabilities, extensive patent portfolio, customized solutions, and a broad product matrix covering coal, minerals, and renewable resource recycling.
